description: Agentless Windows Server health checks over WinRM: one verdict per server, a diffable inventory, and no arbitrary PowerShell.

auth_env_var_specs.name: WINDOWS_SERVER_USERNAME
auth_env_var_specs.description: WinRM account name (a local or domain account in the server's Administrators group)

novel_features.name: Confirm-gated service restart and start
novel_features.description: Restart one running service with services restart, or start a stopped automatic one with services start; each previews first and returns the service state before and after.

novel_features.name: Fleet health verdict
novel_features.description: One ok, warn, crit or unknown verdict per server, with the reason for every failing check and how long it has been failing.

novel_features.name: Inventory snapshot and diff
novel_features.description: What changed in roles, features, shares, local administrators, certificates, installed updates and VMs between the two newest inventory snapshot runs.

novel_features.name: Why is it down
novel_features.description: Stopped automatic services on every server, each paired with the Service Control Manager event that explains the stop.

novel_features.name: Who changed local admins
novel_features.description: Who added or removed each local Administrators member, when, and whether they are still a member.

novel_features.name: Health change feed
novel_features.description: Poll health-state changes between health runs with a sequence cursor.

novel_features.name: New errors on a server
novel_features.description: System and Application errors and warnings whose source and event ID are new on a server compared with its own history.
